claims.claim: Swish containment is exactly a multiplicity-respecting directed-cycle problem.
claims.evidence: After orienting each transformed card from hoop to ball, a Swish has indegree and outdegree exactly one at every used position. Every nonempty finite component is therefore a directed simple cycle, whose corresponding cards form a contained Swish. Conversely, the distinct physical cards realizing any directed simple cycle place exactly one hoop and one ball at each cycle vertex. Requiring each transformation type no more often than its available physical multiplicity makes the correspondence exact. Extra cards in the surrounding collection are irrelevant because containment permits discarding them.
claims.witness: Cards oriented as (1,1)→(1,2) and (1,2)→(1,1) form the minimal two-card cycle and hence a Swish; either card alone does not.
claims.search_method: Direct degree argument in both directions, supplemented by exhaustive exact checks of all 4096 oriented-edge subsets on four vertices and explicit two-cycle/augmentation regressions.

claims.claim: A no-swish collection contains at most 20 distinct transformation types, and this is sharp.
claims.evidence: Exact reconstruction gives four position orbits A,B,C,D of sizes 4,2,4,2 and 36 transformation types. Eight are internal, distributed 3,1,3,1, while the other 28 form 14 cross-orbit reversal pairs. Both members of any reversal pair realize a two-cycle, so a no-swish support uses at most 14 cross types. On each four-position orbit, all three internal types realize a triangle, giving local support maximum two; each two-position orbit has one internal type. Hence the bound is 14+2+1+2+1=20. The stated 20-type construction is cycle-free: every cross arc strictly increases A<B<C<D, while exhaustive local enumeration confirms the six selected internal types contain no realizable cycle.
claims.witness: Take all 14 cross types directed forward under A<B<C<D and the six internal types represented by (1,1)→(1,3), (1,1)→(4,1), (1,2)→(4,2), (2,1)→(2,3), (2,1)→(3,1), and (2,2)→(3,2), one physical card of each type.
claims.search_method: Exact enumeration of the Klein-four symmetry orbits, reversal pairs, every simple cycle within each position orbit, and the rank-monotone 20-type witness.

claims.claim: Unless all eight internal types are duplicated, the usual once-or-twice interpretation of the 60-card deck already yields a 29-card no-swish subset.
claims.evidence: Under the stated once-or-twice hypothesis, if not all eight internal types are doubled, their total multiplicity is at most 15, leaving at least 45 cross cards. Across the 24 total orders of A,B,C,D, each directed cross type is forward in exactly 12 orders. The average forward physical-card count is therefore at least 45/2, so some order selects at least 23. Adding one copy of each of the six safe internal types yields at least 29 cards. Cross arcs strictly increase orbit rank and the internal cards are locally cycle-free, so the collection contains no Swish; arbitrary excess cards may be discarded.
claims.witness: Choose an orbit order attaining the integer-average bound, retain every physical cross card directed forward in that order, and add one copy of each of the six internal types listed in claim 1.
claims.search_method: Exact enumeration of all 24 orbit orders and their incidence with every cross type, followed by integer averaging for each possible internal-card total from 8 through 15 and exact local-cycle checks.

claims.claim: The authorized input omits information essential to deciding the exact commercial-deck target.
claims.evidence: The authorized input states the aggregate facts of 60 physical cards, 36 symmetry types, duplicated equivalent cards, and a known 28-card no-swish subset, but supplies neither the physical-card list nor the 36-entry multiplicity vector. This omission is outcome-determining. Starting with one copy of every type, Deck X adds copies of all eight internal types and both directions in eight reversal pairs. Any no-swish subset then has at most 6 internal plus 16 cards from the eight doubled pairs plus 6 from the remaining pairs, totaling 28; a forward-order witness attains 28. Deck Y instead adds copies of nine forward cross types, all 14 reverse cross types, and one internal type. Its forward types contribute 18+5 cards and the six safe internal cards give a verified 29-card no-swish subset. Both decks have 36 present types, exactly 24 doubled types, 60 physical cards, and a 28-card no-swish subset, yet they give opposite answers to the target.
claims.witness: Deck X: double all eight internal types and both directions of eight reversal pairs. Deck Y: relative to A<B<C<D, double nine forward cross types, all 14 reverse cross types, and one internal type. The persisted checker constructs both exact multiplicity vectors, proves Deck X's bound 28, and verifies Deck Y's 29-card witness.
claims.search_method: Inspection of only the authorized JSON's fields and commercial-deck passages, followed by exact construction and capacity analysis of two compatible 60-card models.

target_evidence: The exact target requires resolving the actual original deck: either prove its maximum no-swish size is 28 or identify and verify at least 29 actual commercial cards forming a no-swish subset. The draft does neither. It proves a correct cycle characterization, a sharp 20-distinct-type bound, a conditional 29-card theorem, and that the supplied aggregate description cannot determine the actual-deck answer. Those are material but incomplete advances, so VALID_PARTIAL_PROGRESS is appropriate. The draft labels its resolution PARTIAL and explicitly says the commercial-deck target remains unresolved, so its claimed resolution is ACCURATE rather than overstated or understated.
